title: Training Neural Networks to be Locally Adaptive
abstract: arXiv:2611.22198v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks fitted by global empirical risk minimization commit to a single model for the entire covariate space. In a regression problem, if the regression function $f_0$ is inhomogeneous --- varying rapidly in one region, while being nearly flat in another --- no single model can be appropriate everywhere, and the fit degrades where the function varies most rapidly. Here we study an alternative in which, instead of fitting the network globally, we fit it locally. For each query point $x$, a \emph{local neural network} is trained on the $k$ nearest-neighbours of $x$ alone, making the training sample and the fitted function query-dependent. We analyze the performance of the resulting estimator through a localization approach, establishing that the pointwise risk of the estimator with an appropriate choice of $k$ attains the rate $n^{-2\alpha/(2\alpha+d^{*})}$, up to logarithmic factors, when $f_0$ is locally $\alpha$-H\"older

translated_title: 训练神经网络使其具有局部自适应性
translated_abstract: 通过全局经验风险最小化拟合的深度神经网络会在整个协变量空间上采用单一模型。在回归问题中，如果回归函数 $f_0$ 是非齐性的——在某一区域变化剧烈，而在另一区域几乎平坦——那么没有任何单一模型能够处处适用，且拟合效果在函数变化最剧烈的区域会退化。本文研究了一种替代方案：不再对网络进行全局拟合，而是进行局部拟合。对于每个查询点 $x$，仅在其 $k$ 个最近邻样本上训练一个“局部神经网络”，使训练样本和拟合函数均依赖于查询点。我们通过一种局部化方法分析了所得估计器的性能，证明了当 $f_0$ 局部满足 $\alpha$-Hölder（条件时，通过适当选择 $k$，该估计器的逐点风险（在相差对数因子的情况下）可以达到 $n^{-2\alpha/(2\alpha+d^{*})}$ 的速率。
tldr: 本文提出针对每个查询点仅用其k个最近邻训练“局部神经网络”的局部自适应拟合方法，并证明了适当选择k时，估计器在局部α-Hölder函数上可达到 $n^{-2\alpha/(2\alpha+d^{*})}$ 的逐点风险速率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes training a "local neural network" on the k nearest neighbors of each query point for locally adaptive fitting, proving that with an appropriate choice of k, the estimator attains the pointwise risk rate $n^{-2\alpha/(2\alpha+d^{*})}$ for locally α-Hölder functions.
